catalog.does_not_agree: The entry and the server's reading don't agree, so there's nothing to sign.
catalog.enrol_text: This {device} makes a key that signs only catalog revisions, and only with {biometry}. Send the key and your operator id to whoever enrols operators.
catalog.label_differs: The entry says {tool} only reads, but its description reads a write
catalog.left_open: {argument} is left open: pin it to {value}, or this can't be published
catalog.not_described: {tool} is in the entry but not in what the server reads
catalog.not_in_entry: {tool} is read from the description but isn't in the entry
catalog.not_what_is_signed: This revision isn't what the connection server signs, so nothing can be signed here. Open it again.
catalog.nothing_to_sign: Only a reviewed revision is published, and only a published one retired.
